notes.title: New game, SPINGUN, out now!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/qEQ6q0p.jpg]

Hey y'all, long time no see. Andrew here. I’m happy to announce the Steam release of my second game, SPINGUN. After the successful release of ‘David.’, I’ve been hard at work honing my craft to create the best games I possibly can. SPINGUN is my latest work, and I sincerely hope you enjoy it.

If you liked 'David.', I have a feeling you'll be intrigued by SPINGUN.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/548230

[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/548230]Steam link[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0q7fQ6ccuJ8]Trailer[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0MBl1y0xoOw]Gameplay[/url][/b]
[b][url=http://www.fermentergames.com/spingun/]Official Site[/url][/b]

[img=http://i.imgur.com/To98i04.jpg]

SPINGUN is a "manic two-button arcade shooter". Two buttons. One spaceship. Zero chance to survive. Use the elegant two-button control scheme to battle against an onslaught of baddies in your ship. Fly and steer with either single button, or press both buttons at once to fire your ship’s powerful blaster gun. Grab powerups to launch missiles, plasma balls, and flames at your foes. Blast em to bits quick to repair your ship. How long can you fight them off?

"Beautifully designed" - TouchArcade
"Intense" - SuperGameDroid

[img=http://i.imgur.com/pRp1G4j.png]

[img=http://i.imgur.com/rRSxrIs.jpg]

SPINGUN features a variety of game modes:
- Endless, a classic “how long can you survive” mode with random weapon powerups
- Endless Hardcore, one hp, no heals, EXTRA DEADLY
- Zones, fight against 5 set waves of curated enemies with only one weapon powerup
- Boss Fights, test your skills against goliath monsters
- Ballpit, a pointless goofy arena filled with balls, have fun with physics!

[b]A quick history:[/b]
SPINGUN started as a 48-hour game-jam project as part of Ludum Dare 34. Since then, I couldn’t stop thinking about the theme of “Two-Buttons”, and how I could get the most depth from a super simple control scheme. I continued development and opened up a public beta through TouchArcade, something I’ve never done before. Thankfully, the testers were really loving it, and gave me quite a few ideas to finish up the game. Even though I developed the game completely myself, I couldn’t have done it without the support and ideas from my friends and testers. I plan on listening to suggestions from players and adding more features and content often.

“This is like Asteroids on steroids!” - a quote that stuck out to me from one of my beta testers.

Anyway, I’m happy to release SPINGUN. I’ve put my heart into this game, and I just hope people enjoy it.

Cheers,
Andrew Armstrong
FermenterGames.com

notes.title: Pricing Change Follow-up!
notes.notes:
As a follow-up to the previous announcement, I just wanted to clarify a few things.

[h1]What's Going On?[/h1]
According to policy, price drops of this nature aren't meant to be changed so soon after launch. Policy is policy, and I have to follow it. We're gonna have to wait this out a couple weeks.

[h1]Timeframe[/h1]
The price will be dropping from $4.99 to $1.99 on Monday, March 16th.

Thanks a ton for all your support and encouragement.

[h1]ALSO[/h1]
I'll be heading to GDC in San Francisco in a few days with a few buddies. Anybody else gonna be there? Any tips for a newbie?

notes.title: Thank you // Pricing Change Announcement!
notes.notes:
Ladies and dudes, it's been an awesome launch and I can't thank you all enough for trying this thing I've worked so hard on.

[h1]First things first[/h1]
I've read every single review, every single discussion post, and I've come to a conclusion; I'm changing the full price of the game from $4.99 to $1.99. 

[b]So please, if you're reading this while the game is $4.99 and you're thinking about buying the game, wait til it's cheaper if you like.[/b] (Edit: Price change will happen 3/16/2015.)

[h1]Here's why[/h1]
Almost all of the reviews that mentioned price said something like "Great game, but maybe not for $4.99". I want to do my best to listen and learn from my customers, and the community is full of pretty smart folks. You guys know my game better than me, and I don't want to ignore that.

I hope you don't think I'm doing anything dishonest here. Really I'm trying to be as transparent as possible. Actually, thank YOU for having been honest about what you think about the price so I can be accurate with my pricing.

[h1]Also![/h1]
I'm still working on David. Look forward to new content soon.

UPDATE: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/david/announcements/detail/243530198176577510]Here![/url]

notes.title: David made it to the big leagues.
notes.notes:
It had been almost a year on Greenlight, and I’d actually given up on Greenlight after it looked like it wasn't going to happen, so it’s really awesome to be telling you about getting Greenlit and the upcoming release.

Thanks to everyone who voted, and thanks to Steam for giving David a fantastic audience.

Making it to Steam is a huge breakthrough for a little developer like me. I've got my foot in the door now, so I'm just gonna walk in and make myself comfortable.

[b]Look for David as it launches for $0.99 at 1PM (PST) on February 16, 2015.[/b]
